name: Machikado no Boulanger ~Chuumon no Ooi Pan'ya-san~
original_name: 街角のブーランジェ～注文の多いパン屋さん～
source:
This bakery exists in the suburbs for several generations. It's famous for fresh bread, cute waitresses and especially for accepting custom orders. Main character needs to manage this enterprise while his parents are away on a trip. There is only his cousin and his childhood friend to help him. This is a story depicts three people's relations deepen as they work together under a single roof.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这家面包店在郊外传承了数代，以新鲜面包、可爱的女店员，尤其是接受定制订单而闻名。父母外出旅行期间，主人公需要负责经营店铺，身边只有表妹和青梅竹马协助。这是一个讲述三人在同一屋檐下共同工作、关系逐渐加深的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
